intro: Make meals feel calmer at a table that soothes your room. Pedestal Pietra Grigia brings a stone-look gloss top, while the central base clears legroom so you settle in, share plates, and linger longer.

features.title: Pedestal base keeps space open
features.text: A single centered support keeps legs clear, so you slide chairs in smoothly and move around freely. You sit closer without knocks, making quiet breakfasts and long suppers feel comfortably unhurried.

features.title: Pietra Grigia top with calm depth
features.text: The stone look high gloss top softens light and adds gentle depth, helping your dining corner feel settled and refined. You pair neutrals or woods easily while the pattern keeps things interesting.

features.title: Comfortable seating for six
features.text: Comfortably seat six so family meals, group projects, or weekend brunches have room to unfold. You set platters and place settings without crowding, keeping the table calm and conversation easy.

features.title: Balanced, dependable build
features.text: A well balanced understructure keeps the table steady while you pass bowls and pour tea, so moments stay relaxed. The design feels substantial yet light enough to keep your room open and airy.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
